fact: ICT Authority Kenya, a state corporation, says it runs a Network Operation Centre and Cloud Data Centre and designs integrated e-services systems for government.

Murang'a Governor Irungu Kang'ata says AfyaKE, adopted from a national government system, was enhanced by the county's in-house software developers and its staff were trained to use it; the Ministry of Health says it is a private arrangement between the county and its developers.
